# Draft:King Python

King Python is a fast and a compiled language developed by [https://github.com/PFM37/ PFMCODES] in November 2024 and discontinued in December 2024 but recontinued in march 2025 and it was first written in  Python  but because of performance issues they switched to Go and you can find the discontinued version at https://github.com/pfm37/king-python
